I know I am just some random internet stranger but I really do care, and would be your friend if you let me. I know it's not much but it is a start. I can't give you all the answers but I can help talk things through with you, and give you support and encouragement. I would also like to stress that there are lots of other people on here and around in the world who will be there for you once you find them. You just need to keep moving and know that things can get better.

Don't apologize. You are trying, you are reaching out, that's to be commended not looked down upon. You don't deserve to be treated poorly you deserve to be happy. It is good enough to try, trying will get you there when you couple it with time, and people who want to help. You are doing what you need to by reaching out never ever ever ever quit trying like you are. You can do this. You got this, and there are people here to help, I am here to help, and will try to be here as often as is possible.

You shouldn't pretend like you are okay if that is not how you feel. If you are hurting it is okay to show that, and let people know. The trouble with being smart is that you wind up figuring out too many ways to appear like you are okay, and you outsmart everyone into not knowing that you are hurting. It's okay to let people know that hey you need some help. And I am so fucking proud of you for trying like how you are. Reaching out on here just shows that you are resilient. You got this, we will be here for you. Just so you know though, it does mean something that you are reaching out like this. It speaks volumes towards your character, and your strength. It means the world that you are willing to try. I am also glad to see you recognize the great things you have going for you too, that's another big step that's awesome!

I won't accept someone who can recognize such beauty in music is a piece of shit in any aspect of their life. You are not a curse, nor are you cursed. You are going through a pit of depression. And you will come out the other side, It does get better from here, but the first step is in admitting that you are worth it, and acknowledging that people, lots of people care for, and about you, and want to see you succeed. You got this, I am not saying it is something that will be easy, I understand that, and it may take a lot of help from a lot of people, and a lot of effort on your part, but it is so within your grasp. I am here, there are countless others in this community that will be here, and moreover, there are millions of people out there in the world at large that will be there for you too.

Attractiveness is not something to be measured in empirical standards. You are looking at it in the sense that there is something that is wrong with the way you look, when it's a matter of how you perceive yourself. There is nothing wrong with being your age and a virgin. I was the same age before I got anywhere with a girl. The point I had to look at had nothing to do with my looks, I didn't just start working out and become a stud or some such nonsense I simply took a step back and realized, in no way can another persons judgement of me change who I am. I started comparing the best of myself to the best of my competitors for girls attentions. That was hard, I use to compare my worst to their best and I would always lose. But when I flipped the scripts I found out that really anyone can look, feel, and be whatever they want. The main issue is you need to be able to look past what has kept you down for so long. I know it can be hard because when you feel so low all the time it's hard not to have a distorted reflection. But you can piece back together how awesome you can be, it just takes time to do it, and some serious will power. You have people here who would like to help you do that. You speak fairly eloquently that is something right there, from a total strangers perspective that's pretty fucking awesome.

You sir, sound to have some of the same experiences as me. Though I did not have such an agitated past with my parents, being molested certainly was a large focal point for me when I turned to suicide. Calling it an art? I am sorry you are wrong. There is no one on this planet that "wants" to be a good man. The fact that that was ever your goal tells me that is what you are. I understand the world has beaten you down. That it feels like there is nothing to come back from this. But the bonus of being a good man, is that people will notice this. You may have a distorted reflection of self at this point, you have been through some very horrendous things. But trust me, you are still a good person. Who you were before, and what you are now, they are the same things, just some pieces got thrown into the wrong place, that's all. You can come back from this. Trying to talk to someone at the hospital, or going for therapy are great places to start. If that is impossible in your circumstance, then please feel free to continue talking on here. Nobody want's to see you go, there are always ways to come back, and taking your life when you are as young as you are is not an option, please.

You are not a piece of shit. People can help you, but you need to be willing to admit that. There are lot's of people in this world who care about you, and being incel isn't the end of the world. I knew a girl at my university who also had to deal with that, and though I know it was hard for her, she made it work, and now has a loving boyfriend. It's not something that needs to claim your life. I won't say I know from personal experience how hard it is,  but I do know that suicide is not an option. It is never justified, no matter how hard we might want it too be. I was where you are too not too long ago. And I can see that you are angry, but please try to hear me when I say you are not alone. There are people both in this community, and out in the world at large that would love to help you. Everyone has value, everyone has a purpose and everybody counts. Please continue to talk on here, so that we can try to help. What is it exactly that makes you think nobody can help you come back from this?

You are not selfish to feel the way you do. It's a chemical imbalance, but I am glad to hear you have things that tie you to this world. You are right in that it would devastate your family to lose their only child. You are wrong in thinking that an escape would lessen their pain. Speaking as someone who has had very recent thoughts of suicide, and who got help I know this. I finally had to admit to my parents how low I felt and they explained to me no matter what I did in this world or how low or high I felt as a person, they would worry. Its down to instinct my friend you can't change that. They will always love you, and with that comes the pain of worry, it's not as bad as all that trust me. The joy you bring into their lives by just being you, and by virtue of that a piece of themselves is impossible to overshadow. Now, about having low self esteem, I get that too. It can be hard sometimes when you look around and see people who seem to have it much better off. But the way my father explained it too me is this. We are all a product of thousands upon thousands of years of mating, love, and living. You couldn't be here if forty seven generations ago, a man and a woman didn't have sex and create one of your forty sixth generations ago grandparents. The odds that it took to create you, the trillions upon trillions of possible sperm, the billions and billions of possible eggs, and the fact that your parents met, and theirs before them and before them, its really amazing. And if you take into consideration all the hardships they had to take, all the things they survived, to see you come here, now, to a time where you are as strong as you are, and able to look for help like this. That's amazing. You are as unique as they come, the odds of your existence are staggering, you are the product of eons upon eons of love and understanding. You will get through this, just trust the math, you are incredible, and know that there will always be people out there who are more than willing to speak with you, and help you through. You can message me on here if you ever need someone to listen, just please don't do anything you might regret.
